player_prompt.intro:
Mo yeke Player {player_id} ({role}) na lê ndozu Matching Pennies tî {num_rounds} ndozu.
- Na ndozu kô ôko, fa '[heads]' ô '[tails]' (ô '[h]', '[t]').
- Tî mo sô ayeke yeke to ayeke adversaire, Player 0 a gagné ndozu; sinon Player 1 a gagné.
Kiri mo pasi na format '[heads]' ô '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mbeni 0 a pili {choice0}; Mbeni 1 a pili {choice1}. Kötä tî Mbeni 0 a siri
message.round_mismatch: Mbeni 0 a pili {choice0}; Mbeni 1 a pili {choice1}. Kötä tî Mbeni 1 a siri

outcome.draw: Na yâ ti ye kue, ala use kue ayeke na kpale.
